preprocessing.sampling: ffmpeg fps filter; times are nominal sampling-grid times
preprocessing.resize: 96x96, FFmpeg Lanczos; pixel parity with Studio not established

verification.scope: Keras float32 on CPU, one process; no TFLite/network/ESP32 verification

parameters.output_reference: suffix on unquantized activations, same batch size (16)
parameters.quantization: rint(float64(x)/step) to signed little-endian int32; no clipping
parameters.temporal: exact signed int32 difference of quantized tensors

scope: offline PC Keras; one video/split; no annotations, network, energy or ESP32 measurements
